purpose: Descriptive extraction, not a new policy selector.
service_vs_reference: Only learner automated rows count as customer automatic service. All reference outcomes remain hypothetical financial results.
conditional_denominator: Observed learner auto_n or reference_available_n as labelled; NULL if zero.
served_subgroup_finding: On the common 48 automatically served paths, saved new and legacy priced financial outcomes are exactly equal. The smaller new total observed breach count is accompanied by withheld automatic service; it is not evidence of improved trading behavior for that same subgroup.

saved_actual_behavior_on_common_served_s.scope: Only the new automatically served OOF subgroup; both inputs are saved actual traces, no simulator called.

paired_denominator: New learner automatic service intersected with comparator financial availability on the same originalscenario and outer fold; common_service_auto applies only to both learners.

summary_metadata.median_method: numpy.median; mean of the two middle values for even sample sizes
summary_metadata.cvar90_definition: average of the worst 10% probability mass, including fractional boundary atoms
summary_metadata.risk_event: MDD - L > 1e-12; smaller differences treated as numerical equality

limits: Reused development; not a fresh blind evaluation or fixed-policy risk certificate.
OOF folds learn different menus/gammas/betas/prices; overlapping training folds do not justify naive pooled binomial certification.
New and legacy raw conditional metrics may describe different automatically served subsets. Coverage is shown alongside risk; only common-evaluable pairs share the same IDs.
Reference assigned_paths means hypothetical financial availability, never automatic customer service; case_auto_n/case_execReview_n stay NULL.
New complete procedure reselects Q1 menu/assignment as well as execution calibration. Differences from legacy are not a pure one-parameter causal effect.
A zero automatic-service denominator gives NULL risk/growth, not zero risk. Observed breaches per original120 do not impute outcomes for Review or outside-Balanced cases.
Risk-only questionnaire process still has an unresolved liquidity service rule; no final service adoption or final policy selection is made.
Nine-price fixed-target family only; no18-controller extension or target update is evaluated here.
Service alpha=.10 is a public policy reference; static gamma and dynamic beta are technical screens, not identified questionnaire preferences.
